description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Birchlore Rangers, adding {G}.
When Birchlore Rangers dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
